description: Toyota's Bridge specialist for the Deployment ADW: lists the projects, checks one's status, health, logs and release history, and after a yes deploys, restarts or rolls back a project
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/bridge_specialist_runner.BridgeSpecialistRunner. The model only picks the operation and fills in project, reason, release id, unit, lines or dry_run; bridge_client/deploy_plans.py builds the exact JSON prompt. Every change is read back and sent only after a yes. The same Bridge agent, worker adapter and ADW (adws/adw_deploy.py) that ChatGPT drives.
